title: A notation's concepts — visual-communication capability
description: Formal shape of a notation's `notation.yaml` (DEC-001 point 5, DEC-004 point 10): the concepts of one subject, each mapped to a colour family the foundations declare, never to a value, so each brand colours a concept its own way. Content names a concept read with the notation's name, `<notation>/<concept>`. Format 1 maps a concept to its colour family alone. Document-shaped schema. Companion per COR-018.

pkit_schema.description: The schema that binds this file (COR-023; DEC-002 point 3): `visual-communication:notation`.

schema_version.description: The format number, shared by every schema of the capability (DEC-003 point 1).

concepts.description: Each concept of the notation's subject, by its name, mapped to the colour family that paints it.

colour.description: A colour family the foundations declare, by its name; never a value.
